jobs.occupation: ALLROUND MASSAGETHERAPIST SPECIALIZED IN BALINESE & THAI MASSAGE
jobs.description:
Wo are we looking for

Experience & Qualifications

Minimum of 1 year of professional experience as a massage therapist and also proficient in Thai and Balinese massage techniques.  Proven ability to perform full-body massage treatments of up to 30-60 minutes. Experience with deep tissue, sports, wellness, or traditional massage techniques. Experience in a spa, wellness centre, or massage clinic is preferred. Knowledge of, or experience with medical massage is a plus. Works with attention, care, and passion for your profession. You are qualified with a relevant diploma or certificate, which is a must.

Ability to work independently and maintain high service standards.
Physically fit and capable of performing multiple treatments per day.
 Good communication skills in English is required. 

Furthermore, you are:
- Communicative and customer-focused
- Sociable, flexible, and stress-resistant
- Professional and quality-conscious
- A true team player

KrungThong Spa is a charming and professional wellness center in Rijswijk, where guests enjoy authentic Thai and Balinese massages in a relaxing atmosphere. We are immediately seeking a (female) all-round massage therapist, specialized in Balinese and/or Thai massage, to join our team. There are two positions open.

What do we offer?

- A busy schedule with many regular clients
- Competitive salary, including holiday pay and holiday leave
- Flexible working hours and vacation days upon request
- Regular staff outings and team-building activities are organized to promote a positive and enjoyable working environment.
- A pleasant working atmosphere in a professional team

DHL Supply Chain Weert – Full-time (40 hours)

"Every day is different, and you help keep the warehouse running." – DHL colleague

As a Warehouse Employee, you help with the daily work in the warehouse. You make sure products are received, checked and moved in the right way. You work together with your team to keep the warehouse safe and organised.

Your daily tasks include:

- Receive and check incoming goods
- Pick and pack customer orders
- Scan products with a hand scanner
- Register products in the warehouse system
- Check products for damage or mistakes
- Report problems to your Team Leader
- Help your colleagues when needed
- Keep your workplace clean and safe

We are looking for someone who likes to work in a warehouse and enjoys working in a team.

You have:

- Basic logistics knowledge (preferred)
- English skills (A/B)
- Basic computer skills
- Experience with a scanner is a plus
- Good attention to detail
- A positive and motivated attitude
- The ability to work alone and with a team
- An EPT certificate is a plus, or you are willing to get one

Secure a guaranteed hourly pay of €16.19 per hour (inclusive of holiday pay) with the ultimate flexible local side job. Walk or cycle your fixed route directly from your front door on the days and times that suit you best.

What we offer
- €16,19 per hour
- Start directly from your door
- Work 2 to 4 hours per week
- No boss: Work 100% on your own terms
- Start directly without experience

Who you are
No prior work experience required! Just make sure all flyers are delivered on time every week :)

- You are living in Amsterdam postal code area 1060 through 1069
- You are available for 2 to 4 hours between Friday and Monday
- You are the owner of a sturdy bicycle with a rear luggage rack
- You are fluent or proficient in English or Dutch
- You are physically capable of walking, cycling, and carrying flyer bundles

What will you do
Deliver weekly promotional flyer packs in your immediate neighborhood. Spotta drops off the flyer packages directly at your home between Thursday and Saturday. Staying home for delivery is not required.

Manage your own time and complete your route by Monday at 7:00 PM at the latest. Open the Spotta app to view the most efficient delivery path, adjust the direction if needed, and engage friendly locals along your route.

- Receive free flyer deliveries directly at your house.
- Launch the neighborhood app and select your route.
- Drop the flyers into letterboxes across your assigned neighborhood.

Where will you work
Spotta and Tempo-Team provide a reliable, flexible workplace. You get direct support via a weekly digital Q&A session and a helpline whenever you need assistance.

You will join Van Wijngaarden, a family business known for its Zaanse mayonnaise since 1929. Together with around 85 colleagues, you work in a modern production environment where quality, technology and teamwork come first. 
Start as a technical production worker at a stable family business and develop your skills in production and technology. Earn up to €3,908 per month including shift allowance, work in a 3-shift system and grow into an operator role. 
About the function 
As a production worker, you work on the packaging lines. You help set up, check and change machines, ensuring the process runs safely and efficiently. You monitor product quality, spot deviations and minor technical issues, and solve them independently where possible. You work closely with operators and colleagues to prevent downtime. 
Technical experience or a strong interest in machines and production is a great fit. You will receive thorough training and can develop towards an operator role. You work Monday to Friday in fixed shifts: 06:00 to 14:00, 14:00 to 22:00 and 22:00 to 06:00. 
What we offer - Salary between €3,315 and €3,908 per month, including shift allowance - Year-end bonus of 4.25% of your annual salary - Direct secondment contract through PDZ - Personal onboarding programme - Training and growth opportunities towards operator - Travel allowance of €0.23 per km from 5 km - Monday to Friday in a fixed 3-shift system 
What we need - You are willing to work in a 3-shift system - You have technical work experience or a strong interest in technology and machines - You work accurately and follow quality and safety rules - You speak Dutch or English

As a CNC Portal Milling Operator in Ede, you work with the newest machines in plastic processing. You work full-time (40 hours) in two shifts: from 6:00 to 14:30 and from 14:30 to 23:00. Together with your team, you deliver high-quality products and enjoy a positive, open working atmosphere.
You program, set up, and operate CNC portal milling machines. You process plastic parts, from single pieces to series. You work with technical drawings and STEP files. You check dimensions and tolerances yourself. You discuss and implement optimizations with your team. You also carry out (preventive) maintenance on machines and tools. You work in a structured way and keep your workplace safe.
Every day is different! You get a lot of freedom and responsibility. You actively contribute to process improvements. You see the results of your craftsmanship right away. Want to work with modern machines and develop yourself further? Apply today! 😊

- MBO (secondary vocational education) working and thinking level, preferably in technology or machining
- At least 2 years of experience with CNC machines
- Experience with programming and reading technical drawings
- Experience with VectorCam
- You work accurately and have an eye for detail
- You actively contribute to improvements
- Team player and communicative
- You speak good Dutch and/or English

In Dordrecht, we are located at Burgemeester van der Dussenstraat 910. Here, we work with our Central Hub Manager Rob and approximately 200 colleagues. Every day, we process up to 200,000 packages here, which can be sorted to 150 locations. In any case, wherever you work: we *always* listen to what you have to say. The more perspectives and opinions we hear, the better we all become. For instance, as an organization, we received the Great Place to Work certificate this year. This certification is based 100% on employee feedback.

As a logistics employee at DHL, you help sort packages. You ensure that every package ends up in the right place. Without your help, the packages would not be sorted on time and would not be delivered to the customer on time.

You can start as a ‘packer’, where you place the packages on the conveyor belt so they can be sorted. You can start as a ‘packer’, where you take sorted packages off the conveyor belt and place them in a cart. Later, at DHL, you can also learn and perform other tasks in the warehouse.

Please note: a package can weigh a maximum of 25 kilos. Not every package is that heavy, but it can happen. You must always lift heavier packages together with a colleague.

Working hours/shifts vary between 17:00 and 02:00.

- You are available for at least 4 days a week between 17:00 and 02:00;
- You can lift packages weighing up to a maximum of 25 kilos;
- You have your own transport (car, bicycle, scooter, or you live within walking distance);
- You speak Dutch or English so that you can communicate well with your team.
- You are at least 18 years old.
- Residing in the area of Dordrecht / Rotterdam / Schiedam / Capelle aan den IJssel

READY TO TAKE YOUR WAREHOUSE SKILLS TO THE NEXT LEVEL?

Are you an experienced warehouse worker and confident operating warehouse equipment? Join DHL Supply Chain in Weert as an EPT, OPT, Reachtruck or Forklift Driver!

- Full-time availability – You are available for 40 hours per week. Shifts from 06:00 - 15:00 & 15:00 - 00:00, rotating weekly.
- Relevant experience – Experience with EPT, OPT, reachtruck or forklift work is preferred.
- Certificate – A valid certificate for the equipment you operate is a plus.
- Own transportation – You can independently travel to and from work.
- English skills – You can communicate in English at work.
- Safety-minded & reliable – You work carefully, take responsibility and follow safety instructions.
- Team player – You enjoy working together with colleagues to get the job done.
